title: no sync autosense NSCLIENT
body:
like title.
in nsclient it often happens that the autosense percentage is not aligned with androidaps master.
not only the value on the main screen but also the history on the graph.
I attach photos of the same moment of the data in nightscout and of the screen.
![1](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/24631990/02203e10-40fe-4273-8a11-5615089bfcf4)
![2](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/24631990/75a9a534-0f55-4380-857d-510db0957783)
![3](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/24631990/49c175dd-3945-41e2-82c5-f231e9d289dc)
naturally on the master phone there was the right value, 87%.
here is pics for autosens graph. first is master, second is nsclient
![master](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/24631990/c411de46-2929-406a-94d1-16f54a256bf5)
![client](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/24631990/6aa3a35f-aa5a-4bf3-8414-7b6a31ac14f1)

comments.body: this value is calculated on both sides independently. what all data is synchronized value is the same. it may take some time on new installations
